exposure: heterozygous missense variant c.170G > A (p.R57H) in the YWHAG gene
cohort: A proband and his mother from a Chinese family who exhibited early-onset seizures, intellectual disability, and developmental delay.
finding: The study confirmed that a heterozygous missense variant, c.170G > A (p.R57H), in the YWHAG gene, leading to YWHAG haploinsufficiency, caused early-onset epilepsy and developmental delay, consistent with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 56.
